title: SS27 Toddler Girls' Season Colour Analysis
summary: Soft pastels with coral and lemon for SS27 toddler girls.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Piccoli Principi's "Pearl & Tides" swimwear runs from vintage pink to pastel green and soft navy, in technical fabrics including sustainable lycra, with UV protection<sup>[1]</sup>
- At Playtime Paris, red "emerged as one of the defining colors of the season"; stripes ran horizontal, vertical and diagonal<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: The palette
sections.body:

Confirm codes against a physical Pantone book before dyeing.

sections.heading: Colour groups
sections.body:
- **Core:** sand, white.
- **Seasonal:** lavender, coral, aqua.
- Playful colour remains important for this age; keep brights as accents.

design_implications:
- Low-impact, skin-friendly dyes; check colour fastness to saliva and sweat where required.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Depth in sand and white basics.
